meta.title: Groq dictation
meta.description: Record from the composer with a microphone button and let Groq Whisper transcribe it into the draft.

settings.title: Groq dictation
settings.desc: Record with the microphone button in the composer and have Whisper write what you say. The key stays on this computer and is never sent to the browser.
settings.loadError: The dictation settings could not be read.
settings.apiKeyPlaceholderSaved: Enter a new key to replace the saved one
settings.needKey: Enter a key to turn dictation on.
settings.privacy: Audio is sent to Groq only when you stop recording.
settings.secureContextHint: On a phone, open the GUI over HTTPS (the tunnel link): Safari and Chrome block the microphone on plain HTTP.
settings.hostMicDesc: When the browser cannot record (Safari on a phone over HTTP), dictation records with this computer's microphone. Useful when you are near it.
settings.hostMicUnavailable: No microphone this computer can record from.

model.distil-whisper-large-v3-en: Distil Whisper Large v3 · English only

mic.notConfigured: Add your Groq API key in Settings → General to use dictation.
mic.recordingAriaHost: Recording with the computer microphone, {time}. Press Enter to finish.

error.missing-api-key: No Groq API key is configured.
error.invalid-key: Groq rejected the API key. Check it in Settings → General.
error.rate-limited: Groq is receiving too many requests. Try again in a moment.
error.audio-too-large: The recording is too long for Groq.
error.empty-transcript: No speech was detected in the recording.
error.unsupported-audio: This browser produced an audio format Groq does not accept.
error.bad-request: Groq could not process the recording.
error.timeout: Groq took too long to answer.
error.invalid-api-key: That API key does not look valid.
error.invalid-model: The selected Whisper model is not available.
error.invalid-json: The settings request was not valid JSON.
error.invalid-settings: The saved settings file is damaged.
error.microphone-denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser and try again.
error.microphone-insecure: The microphone needs HTTPS. Open the app with the tunnel link, not the LAN address.
error.microphone-unsupported: This browser does not expose a microphone to the page.
error.microphone-busy: The microphone is in use by another app or call. Close it and try again.
error.microphone-failed: The microphone could not be opened.
error.not-configured: Add your Groq API key in Settings → General to use dictation.
error.host-mic-unavailable: This computer has no microphone dictation can use.
error.host-mic-disabled: The computer microphone is turned off in Settings → General.
error.host-mic-failed: The computer microphone could not be opened.
error.not-recording: There was no recording to stop.
